skill.summary: Use when the user needs to interact with X (Twitter) - searching tweets, looking up users/followers, downloading media, monitoring accounts in real time, ext...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Updated skill description to clarify security practices and confirmation requirements for actions like posting, liking, and billing.
- Expanded and detailed the security and privacy policy, including handling of credentials, X account isolation, and payment/billing mitigations.
- Added explicit statement that no X account login material is ever collected, transmitted, or stored; X account connection is user-controlled via the Xquik dashboard only.
- Clarified content trust boundaries: API metadata is trusted, X user-generated content (tweets, bios, DMs) is untrusted and isolated in agent responses.
- Listed new explicit confirmation requirements (write, payment, resource creation) for sensitive or persistent operations.
- Added details on sensitive data endpoints (DMs, bookmarks, timeline, notifications) and mandatory explicit user approval before accessing them.
- Improved metadata for credential handling, execution model, and audit logging.
